verdict.rationale: The docs reference narrow public API surfaces: a Deployments API and dSYM, ProGuard and JS file uploads authenticated with an external access token, plus source-map upload via the API. An official MCP server also exists, which implies programmatic access. However, the pack shows no general API for querying errors or changing their statuses, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: documented general-purpose API covering core crash-reporting workflows (querying error groups, resolving/ignoring), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
